severity_guardrails.1-3: monitor; do not force progression if pain rises during the session
severity_guardrails.4-6: when movement joint-load is high, reduce/modify and use only pain-free range/variation
severity_guardrails.7-10: when movement loads the painful region, avoid forcing the movement; consider assessment, especially if persistent

note: These thresholds are app safety guardrails, not validated diagnostic cutoffs. Exercise-specific joint-load scores are engineering/biomechanical heuristics.
